title: Defending a Coworker's Reputation
paragraphs: During lunch, a group of coworkers begins spreading an unfounded rumor about an absent colleague, exaggerating a small mistake into something that sounds far more serious than what actually happened.
Layla, who knows the real details of the situation firsthand, feels uncomfortable staying silent while an inaccurate and damaging version of events spreads further among the group.
She speaks up calmly, correcting the exaggerated details and reminding everyone gently that spreading unverified information about someone who is not present to defend themselves is unfair to them.

The conversation shifts afterward, and a coworker later thanks Layla privately for stopping the rumor before it reached their manager. Layla explains that protecting someone's reputation felt like the only right choice.
